translate_en|mods/Zombies Congelados TWD: Gradually slows each zombie according to its own internal thermal temperature before full freezing.
First cold slowdown stage when Walker Shamblers behavior is disabled. Default: 5 C.
Second cold slowdown stage when Walker Shamblers behavior is disabled. Default: 2 C.
With vanilla behavior, zombies stop lunging and transition to Walker-style movement. With Walker Shamblers enabled, this is the first additional cold stage. Default: 0 C.
Final moving stage before full freezing. Zombies use slower Walker-style movement. With Walker Shamblers enabled, this is the second additional cold stage. Default: -3 C.
Shows local ambient temperature, individual thermal temperature, current stage, animation state, resistance and indoor/outdoor status. This option does not alter gameplay values.
Allows zombies to become completely frozen and inactive when their individual thermal temperature reaches the configured freezing point.
When a zombie reaches this internal thermal temperature it becomes fully frozen and inactive. Default: -5 C. It must warm about 2 C above this point to thaw.

Enabled: zombies use the integrated Walker Shamblers movement at normal temperature, then two slower cold stages. Disabled: zombies keep vanilla behavior at normal temperature, then pass through four progressive cold stages.
